items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I heard them at the ballpark, Third and Willa.

ctx.x: Where did you hear those? At the dances?

I saw them up there, yeah, I heard them at the ballpark, Third and Willa. And they used to have dances there. And I'd hear them at Third and Willa, Six and Willa, wherever there was a saloon. Well you'd hear that music for miles and as kids we'd just start the looping and follow the sound. That was National Park, yeah, Third and Willa, National Park. Punch totals.
